about_the_game:
🤝 Prepare During the Day

Gather up to 4 friends and work together to strategically plan. Upgrade your hero’s skills each day, and gather resources to upgrade a variety of weapons in preparation for the deadly nights.

⚔️ Survive the Night

Hope you have prepared enough. The night brings high-intensity survival. Blast through waves of deadly zombies and elite bosses by working together with your squad. Rely on your friends and their distinct classes: Tank DPS and Healer, and make it to another day.

🧟 Survive in two modes

  • Main Scenario Mode: Explore the apocalyptic world and characters by progressing through story-driven stages with increasing difficulty.

  • Endless Challenge Mode: Truly test your skills and survive as long as you can against never-ending waves of zombies.

🛠️ Under Development

The Last Squad is a work in progress. New features like Hero Traits and Customization are currently in the works, and features may change in the future.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

name: The Last Squad

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Survive the night. Prepare in the day. Battle waves of zombie hordes in a fast-action third-person shooter with up to 4 friends with The Last Squad. Choose your class and work together, upgrade your squad, and most importantly: Stay alive.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
